metadata.notes: Trigger: fires the moment someone submits your Facebook Lead Ad form. Connect your Facebook account and pick the Page + Form.
Router splits into 3 parallel paths: SMS, CRM log, owner alert.
Path A: instant SMS in under 60 seconds. Studies show 78% of buyers pick whoever responds first.

parameters.body: Hi {{1.full_name}}, thanks for your interest in {{env.BUSINESS_NAME}}! We got your request and will call you within 15 minutes. Need us sooner? Call {{env.BUSINESS_PHONE}}.

metadata.notes: Path B: every lead logged to Google Sheets with timestamp + source.
Path C: owner gets an instant email alert with the lead's details.

parameters.subject: New lead: {{1.full_name}} ({{1.phone_number}})
